messages.author: Priya Raman
messages.text: My join of ua_spend to cohorts gives 3x the installs the dashboard shows. What am I doing wrong?

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Classic creative fan-out :slightly_smiling_face: ua_spend has one row per creative (3 per campaign), cohorts has none. Sum ua_spend by date/channel/campaign/country/platform first, then join on date = install_date. Installs reconcile exactly after that.
